raw_trajectory_source: run-detail API harbor.trajectory, corresponding to the Dashboard Raw trajectory region

selection_policy.both_one: 3 tasks sampled deterministically with seed=batch_id, both model runs

fitness_for_use.complete_raw_trajectories: failure taxonomy, paired behavioral comparison, Tool/context pattern discovery
fitness_for_use.synthetic_placeholders: capture reliability and pre-provider failure analysis only

known_limitations: The historical Raw trajectory schema does not expose provider-bound prompt/output/reasoning/cache token truth.
Historical character counts are proxies and must not be reported as provider token or billing metrics.
Raw execution content is retained in the access-controlled source and is not required in the source repository.
